title: Water Dispenser 12-Step Chemical Sanitization Checklist
description: Standardized 12-step sanitization cycle for water dispensers using Sumatab 150ppm solution with 15-minute contact time.

questions.question: Step 1: Select the dispenser to be cleaned
Step 3: Remove the top & inner accessories
Step 4: Drain the washes water from the hot and cold nozzel completely
Step 5: Add sumatab solution of 150ppm & allow contact time of 15 minutes
Step 6: Manually clean the surface of inner with soft nylon brush
Step 7: Use the fresh solution to clean the top & inner accessory
Step 8: Rinse the top & inner accessory with potable water
Step 9: Pour a liter of potable water a long the wall side if inner surface
Step 10: Again pour water along the wall side of inner surface
Step 11: Drain the water from hot & cold nozzel completely
Step 12: Replace the wash top and inner accessory
Step 13: The jar is placed on the dispenser
